subject: How to read information from shiny for Stan object

messages.author: f8a4136bfeaed71c
messages.subject: How to read information from shiny for Stan object
parts:
Hi all,

After fitting a model with Stan, I check convergence with shiny which gives a lot of plots and summaries by using

launch_shinystan(model2)

That is very useful tool for plotting and computing statistics. However, there are many things that I do not fully understand and not know how to read the information, for example the plot in the attachment.

So do you know where we have a complete tutorial explaining how to read the outputs (plots, numbers) after using shiny?

Thank you for your time,

Kind regards,
Tran.

messages.author: 40bef15e0492270c
messages.subject: Re: How to read information from shiny for Stan object
parts:
Hi Tran,

I don't know any specific tutorial, but the plot you posted indicates that there are divergent transitions in your samples past warm-up. Michael Betancourt posted a case study on divergences and bias using NUTS: http://mc-stan.org/documentation/case-studies/divergences_and_bias.html

Cheers.
